title: Precision flooring spacers (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6mm)
author: Birk78
description:
## Precision Flooring Spacers Set (1–6 mm)

This is a complete set of precision flooring spacers designed to help you achieve accurate and consistent expansion gaps when installing laminate, vinyl, engineered wood, or hardwood flooring.

The set includes the following dimensions:

- 1 mm
- 2 mm
- 3 mm
- 4 mm
- 5 mm
- 6 mm

### Why You’ll Love Them

✔ Accurate and consistent spacing

✔ Clearly defined dimensions writting on the spacers

✔ Compact and easy to handle and remove

✔ Reusable and durable

✔ Perfect for DIY and professional installers

These spacers are ideal for creating clean, uniform expansion gaps along walls, door frames, cabinets, and fixed structures. Having multiple size options makes it easy to match manufacturer requirements or adapt to different room conditions.

### Printing Recommendations

- Print in PLA, PETG, or ABS
- 3–4 perimeters for strength
- 20–40% infill is sufficient
- No supports required

For best durability in repeated use, PETG or ABS is recommended as those a re more flexible and less prone to break.
